notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (Shopify store bloomr-dubai.myshopify.com); robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: fetched /sitemap_collections_1.xml (270+ collection URLs) and cross-checked against full main-nav/mega-menu + footer link extraction from the homepage HTML, plus site search (/search?q=bestsellers). Main nav/footer expose NO explicit Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular link anywhere (checked every <a> on the homepage for best|popular|trend|favor|top - only found via sitemap, i.e. these are orphan/unlinked collections, a common Shopify pattern). Site search for 'bestsellers' returned '1-12 of 34 products' (non-discriminating/loose text match, treated as supporting evidence only, not proof). Found and opened 4 genuine bestseller-labeled PLPs via sitemap: /collections/best-sellers (H1 'Best Sellers', 32 products), /collections/best-selling (H1 'Best selling', 6 products - confirmed genuinely different product set from best-sellers via product-handle comparison, zero overlap sampled, so kept as separate row not an alias), /collections/bloomr-best-30-selling-artificial-trees (title 'Best 30 Selling Artificial Trees', but header shows 270 products, not 30 - flagged, see below), /collections/bloomr-best-30-selling-lighting-items (title 'Best 30 Selling Lighting Items', header shows 6 products - same naming mismatch, flagged). EXCLUDED as non-bestseller editorial curation (opened and confirmed real PLPs but not data-driven bestseller/popularity listings): /collections/mimmis-designer-favorites (71 products, 'Favorites' here = a named designer's personal curated picks, not customer/best-selling popularity), /collections/the-design-edit (18 products, editorial edit), /collections/designers-collection (50 products, editorial curation) - none carry Bestsellers/Top-Selling/Popular/Customer-Favorites wording, they read as stylist-curated collections. Arabic locale (/ar/) mirrors the same Shopify catalog via translated strings only; no separate Arabic-only bestseller collection was found in the sitemap. No Bestsellers badge-only PDPs were mistaken for PLPs - all 4 rows below are confirmed real product-grid listings with pagination and their own header count.

rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: page is titled 'Best 30 Selling Artificial Trees' but the site's own count header reports 270 products, far more than a curated top-30 list. Confirmed it is a genuine, distinct listing (only 19 of 79 sampled page-1 handles overlap with the general Artificial Trees category, which itself totals 611 products), but the name-vs-count mismatch means it is unclear how strictly this remains a bestseller-ranked subset vs a broader trees grouping that kept an old collection name.
